For most **100–150 W electric blankets**, I’d choose the **[BLUETTI Elite 100 V2](https://www.blackoutwise.com/best/best-power-station-for-electric-blanket)**. Its 1,024 Wh battery is estimated to run a 150 W blanket for about 12 hours—enough for an eight-hour night with some margin.

Check the wattage on your blanket’s label: runtime varies, and a blanket that draws around **260 W continuously** could need roughly **2,600 Wh** for eight hours, allowing for power-conversion losses ([runtime estimates](https://homepowerfacts.com/can-it-run/electric-blanket/)). Plug the blanket directly into the station and keep the station off the bed and away from the blanket’s folds.
